Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded the limit was “10 games per year per developer” by conflating Nintendo’s documented NES licensing cap of five titles per year per publisher with the workaround of using multiple imprints (e.g., Konami/Ultra). This misinterpreted Nintendo’s actual limit (five per year) and shifted scope from per publisher to per developer, leading to the wrong final answer.
